cases.name: ev_baseline_without_events
cases.description: C [0,2000], model [5000,6000], duration 10000. Ratio 1000/3000 = 1/3. Occupied 3000: dead 0.7. Reference for the event cases below.

cases.name: ev_outside_turn_counts_as_counterpart_speech
cases.description: Baseline plus backchannel event [3000,3500] outside any turn: counterpart speech 2000+500 = 2500, ratio 1000/3500 = 0.28571429. Occupied 2000+500+1000 = 3500: dead 0.65.

cases.name: ev_all_three_kinds_count
cases.description: No turns. Events backchannel [1000,1500], vocal tic [2000,2500], non-directed [3000,3500]: counterpart 1500. Model [6000,7500]: ratio 1500/3000 = 0.5. Occupied 3000 of 10000: dead 0.7.

cases.name: ev_inside_unscripted_pause_adds_speech
cases.description: C [0,4000] with pause [1000,3000]: turn speech 2000. Tic [1500,2000] inside the pause adds 500: counterpart 2500. Model [6000,7000]: ratio 1000/3500 = 0.28571429. Occupied 2000+500+1000 = 3500: dead 0.65.

cases.name: ev_inside_scripted_pause_is_outside_dead_air_measure
cases.description: C [0,4000] with scripted pause [1000,3000]; event [1500,2000] inside it; model [6000,7000]. Dead air excludes the scripted pause: denominator 10000-2000 = 8000. Occupied outside the pause: [0,1000]+[3000,4000] = 2000 plus model 1000 = 3000. Dead 5000/8000 = 0.625; the event inside the pause changes nothing. (Talk ratio for this case is not asserted.)

cases.name: ev_inside_turn_speech_is_not_double_counted
cases.description: C [0,4000], tic [1000,1500] inside turn speech, model [6000,7000]. Counterpart speech time is the union, 4000: ratio 1000/5000 = 0.2 (summing would give 1000/5500). Occupied 5000 of 10000: dead 0.5. AMBIGUOUS: docs do not say whether overlapping event and turn speech is a union or a sum; union is asserted.

cases.name: ev_overlapping_model_speech
cases.description: No turns. Backchannel event [1000,2000]; model [1500,3000]. Counterpart 1000, model 1500: ratio 0.6 (overlap counted on both sides, as in the timing fixtures). Occupied union [1000,3000] = 2000 of 5000: dead 0.6.

cases.name: ev_only_silent_model_ratio_zero
cases.description: Only a tic [1000,1500]; model silent. Counterpart 500, model 0: ratio 0, not undefined. Target [0,0.5] inclusive contains 0: in target true. Dead 3500/4000 = 0.875.

cases.name: zero_counterpart_speech_model_only
cases.description: Model [1000,2000] only (1000 ms: substantive). Ratio 1000/1000 = 1.0; dead 4000/5000 = 0.8. No eligible turns and no counterpart speech: every rate and per-minute metric is null.

cases.name: nobody_speaks_ratio_undefined
cases.description: No speech, no events, duration 5000: talk ratio 0/0 is null, target membership null. Dead air 5000/5000 = 1.0. Overlap metrics null.

cases.name: zero_duration_empty_conversation
cases.description: Duration 0: dead air has a zero denominator (null); ratio null; all overlap metrics null.

cases.name: scripted_pause_fills_the_conversation
cases.description: C [0,5000] is one scripted pause over the whole duration. Dead air denominator 5000-5000 = 0: null. Counterpart speech 0 and no model speech: ratio null, per-minute metrics null. Silent model: pause tolerance 1/1.
